items.text: Lantern Festival access route: the temporary ramp at the east door needs a second handrail before the public rehearsal.
Photo transcription: EAST ENTRANCE. Second rail fitted. Ramp slope checked at rehearsal; the mat still curls at its lower edge.
I renamed the east ramp checklist to Step-free arrival. Keep the old rail measurements; the only remaining task is securing that curled mat.
Lantern Festival live captions: borrow a tablet for the speech-to-text operator and check that the projector can display two lines at once.
Video transcript of the caption rehearsal: the last word disappears when a speaker pauses. The tablet still sends the complete sentence to the projector.
For the festival's speech display, disable the auto-clear timer. Two-line captions now remain visible through a pause.
Community garden: order replacement mesh for the pea bed after the pigeons pulled out the seedlings.
Garden receipt: fine bird mesh for the pea bed, collected on Wednesday. Pegs supplied with the roll.
Festival handover: Maya will secure the east ramp mat, and Ben will retest caption persistence during pauses. Both checks must finish before doors open.
The check went well. Please ask Maya to bring the spare one before we open.
Cedar Court, flat 8: water appears below the shower tray only while the shower is running. Plumber's estimate 104 covers resealing the waste fitting.
Plumber estimate 104 — Cedar Court flat 8, shower waste reseal, access through the removable bath panel. Roof work excluded.
Correction to the flat eight shower log: the ceiling stayed dry for twenty minutes, not two. The newly sealed waste fitting held during the longer test.
Cedar Court roof: rain enters around the stairwell skylight. Roofer's estimate 104 is for replacing the lifted flashing.
Roof inspection transcript: water tracks underneath the skylight flashing when we spray the uphill corner. The stairwell stain grows; apartments are not being tested.
The skylight flashing was replaced this morning. Schedule the stairwell repaint after the next rain confirms the roof is dry.
My folding bicycle skips gears under load. Order a new rear shift cable before the commute gets longer next month.
The folder shifts cleanly after replacing its frayed rear cable. Keep the old housing; there was no kink in it.
Cedar Court access schedule: let the plumber into flat eight to test the shower seal at nine, then give the roofer the stairwell key for the skylight flashing check at eleven.
Torn invoice corner: estimate 104, balance payable after the water test. Contractor name and site description are missing.
Cress cold-storage study: refrigerate half of lot Willow before sowing. Germination after storage is the outcome; all trays receive plain water.
Bench sheet: Willow, refrigerated half, 18 of 24 emerged. Room-stored half, 21 of 24. Plain water in every tray.
For the chilled cress trial, repeat the count tomorrow; two shoots were hidden by the tray rim. No change to the storage groups.
Cress salinity study also uses lot Willow. Store every seed at room temperature; compare plain water with two salt concentrations after sowing.
Salinity tray recording: the high-salt group has shorter roots than the plain-water control. Count seedlings before taking the root photographs.
Amend the salt protocol: solutions are 5 and 10 millimolar, not percent. Relabel both Willow treatment bottles before repeating the root measurements.
Portfolio site: make the photography page keyboard accessible. The thumbnail modal currently traps focus after closing.
The portfolio gallery now returns keyboard focus to the thumbnail that opened it. Verify Escape closes the image dialog as well.
Willow seed allocation: reserve 48 for the refrigerated versus room-storage experiment, and 72 for the three watering conditions in the salinity experiment. Keep outcome sheets separate.
The Willow control looks healthy today. Take another photograph before moving the tray.
Harbor Voices long episode: assemble the retired ferry pilot's interview chronologically. Keep the full storm rescue account after the childhood section.
In the ferry pilot's full interview cut, remove the repeated childhood question but leave her pause before the storm rescue story.
Harbor Voices episode export is 42 minutes. The childhood section now leads directly into the rescue account with the original pause intact.
Harbor Voices launch trailer: make a 30-second vertical teaser from the ferry pilot interview. Use the rescue line first, then the release date.
Vertical teaser review: the pilot's rescue line ends at twelve seconds. Place the release-date card before the closing wave sound.
Trailer timeline screenshot transcription: 00:00 rescue quote; 00:12 release date; 00:27 Harbor Voices logo; total 00:30.
Passport renewal: retake the photograph because the background shadow failed the upload check. Keep the application reference in the appointment email.
Renewal upload confirmation: replacement passport photograph accepted. Appointment remains Friday at 10:20.
Harbor Voices release checklist: export the full ferry interview with chapter marks and export the thirty-second vertical trailer with burned-in captions. Archive each edit session separately.
The rescue line is too quiet. Bring it up a little and send me the new export.
